title: 7.1 The Body
unit_title: Unit 7: Everyday Needs and A1 Integration
unit_outcome: Handle basic physical needs, weather, clothing, leisure, invitations, and requests for help.
lesson_title: Unit 7: Everyday Needs and A1 Integration
goal: Recognize and name eight common body parts using my + noun chunks.
grammar_function: My + body part; singular and plural body-part chunks without introducing an unplanned demonstrative.
prerequisite: 3.7 possessive adjectives; 6.4 left/right; singular/plural be from Unit 1.
speaking_outcome: Say six representative my + body-part chunks; ears and arms receive planned spoken retrieval in 7.9.

cards.pedagogy_note: New irregular plural lexical form; do not introduce foot separately on this card.
Purposeful singular body-part retrieval with no new demonstrative.
Plural body-part retrieval; region boundary remains decisive.
Target may need /θ/ coaching only after a miss.
Irregular plural accepted as lexical target.
